items.summary: ウィスコンシン州WEDCのIdle Sites Redevelopment Programにより、South Milwaukee市に$250,000の助成金が交付され、予定投資額は$32.67Mとされている。受領者は市当局(Public Admin)で遊休地の再開発が目的。
items.infer: 遊休地の再開発事業であり、跡地に工場等が誘致されれば設備需要が発生する可能性がある(推論)。
items.verbatim: WEDC Grant under the Idle Sites Redevelopment Program program, awarded 2025-05-20 to a recipient in City of South Milwaukee, Milwaukee County. Industry: Public Admin (NAICS 921100). Award amount: $250,000. Planned project cost: $518,320. Planned capital investment: $32,674,411.

items.summary: Wisconsin WEDCがSouth Milwaukee市に$250,000のCommunity Development Investment助成金を交付。受領者の業種は不動産業(NAICS 531120)で、計画投資額は$2.95Mとされる。
items.verbatim: WEDC Grant under the Community Development Investment program, awarded 2021-01-20 to a recipient in City of South Milwaukee, Milwaukee County. Industry: Real Estate (NAICS 531120). Award amount: $250,000. Planned project cost: $2,953,590. Planned capital investment: $2,953,590.
